description: Chintu aur Mithu ke saath mazaak dance aur movement seekhein. Bachon ke gross motor skills aur focus badhane ke liye best song hai.
learning: Listening skills and physical coordination through movement.

scenes.text:
कूदो, घूमो, और हो जाओ फ्रीज,
चिंगू-मिठू नाचें, देखो प्लीज!
scenes.image_prompt: A cute orange baby elephant with a blue scarf and a tiny green parrot with a yellow tummy standing on a sunny garden lawn smiling.

scenes.text:
Jump up high, touch the sky,
Spin around, give it a try!
scenes.image_prompt: The orange elephant jumping in the air and the green parrot spinning with wings spread wide, bright sunny sky.

scenes.text:
एक हाथी और एक तोता प्यारा,
खेलें मिलके, यह नज़ारा न्यारा!
scenes.image_prompt: An orange baby elephant and a green parrot standing together on a colorful play mat indoors.

scenes.text:

Mithu flies around the sky of blue.

scenes.image_prompt: Close up of the orange elephant jumping happily over a small pebble.

scenes.text:
Mithu spins like a colorful top,
He loves to dance and never stop.
scenes.image_prompt: The green parrot spinning fast on a wooden floor, motion blur effect.

scenes.text:

मिठू बोले, चलो खेलें खेल साफ़!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu the elephant waving his blue scarf with his trunk.

scenes.text:

Jump with a friend, as we always do.

scenes.text:

Happiest song that you ever heard.
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu and Mithu singing together in a friendly forest clearing.

scenes.text:

scenes.image_prompt: Chintu putting a finger to his lips, keeping silent and still.

हंसते-हंसते, अब घर को चलें हम!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu waving his blue scarf goodbye, Mithu flying away.

scenes.text:
Goodnight little friends, it's time for rest,
Playing with you is truly the best.
scenes.image_prompt: A sunset background with Chintu and Mithu sitting together, waving.
